strict_docs: uv run --group docs mkdocs build --strict --site-dir /tmp/lhre-imu-stop-docs passed
live_capture: Headless, stationary requested; physics and commands independently verified

native_ros_input_equivalence.note: Use complete native sensor inputs after verifying identical bridged values; bag recording can miss messages that the live EKF received.

replay_fidelity.note: Recorded bag inputs can omit samples received by the live EKF; compare noncoincident output/correction timestamps to avoid callback-order ambiguity.

scope: Actual per-fix diagnostic logging plus offline calibration controls; no live calibration, stationary-state update, mapping fix, driving/gate or physical validation
